draft.subject: Following up on your first project
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Glad the notification badge issue is sorted on our end -- do let me know if it crops up again. I also saw we missed each other last week, no problem at all.

You've got your first project set up and an invite out, which is a great start. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so the next step is usually getting real work into that project.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you and answer anything.

Best,
Nadia
